description: Physical goods with an objective specification, such as commodities or electronics. Evidence: inspection and lab reports signed by a pre-agreed inspector, dispatch photos, and a seal id. Judge: the named inspector.

notes.windows: Funding 48 h, delivery 21 d for shipping, inspection 72 h after arrival. Tier 1 48 h, Tier 2 lab report 5 d, Tier 3 72 h, return 14 d. The 30 d dispute window covers the worst case.
notes.remedy: Default: off-spec goods pay 70 percent. The 30 percent holdback goes back to the buyer. Two escrows, because a Masumi escrow releases all or nothing.
notes.judge: The contract names one whitelisted inspector as the judge. At Tier 2, a lab_report signed by that inspector and bound to this contract and milestone decides. FAIL: the buyer wins. PASS: the seller wins. Conflicting or missing reports go to Tier 3.
notes.fees: Tiers 1 and 2 are free. The party that orders the lab pays the lab outside escrow. Tier 3 costs 5 test USDM. The loser pays.
